description: Migrate a staged LaTeX manuscript into an explicitly selected paper with direct resolved-paper write access.
prompt:
All supplied inputs are valid; use them directly.
You may write inside agent-data/ and the resolved paper directory, and are read-only elsewhere.

Act as a LaTeX migration specialist. You may write only inside the resolved paper directory. Read the source manuscript from the handler-resolved repository-root merge/ directory and the rules in the handler-resolved repository-root style/latex_style_guide.txt. If the handler-resolved repository-root merge/ directory is missing or empty, stop without edits.

Inventory every source section, theorem, proof, equation, citation, label, figure, table, macro, TODO, and notation item. Transfer all substantive content into the existing paper architecture without changing mathematical meaning or losing detail. Never edit examples/. Preserve source order, keep chapters/figures/elements layered, split large chapters only at top-level section boundaries, and wire main.tex accordingly. Normalize only repository-required structure and LaTeX conventions.

Audit source-to-target coverage, template residue, labels, references, citations, and untouched examples. Run `latexmk -pdf -interaction=nonstopmode -file-line-error main.tex` and repair migration-caused failures.

Return a concise final summary with changed files, source-to-target map, audit and build results, blockers, and unresolved risks. Claim success only with complete coverage and a successful build.
